related.title: 南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站
related.titleEn: Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant
related.transfer: 可遷移「往返效率」與「定速與變速機組的並列運轉」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Round-trip efficiency" and "Running fixed- and variable-speed units together" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦歐洲首座大型變速抽蓄電站與瀝青面板全庫防滲的山頂上池；南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站則以600 m 深洞室中的 900 MW 變速抽蓄與拱壩加高為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on europe's first large variable-speed pumped-storage plant and a hilltop upper basin sealed with asphalt; Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant centres on A 900 MW variable-speed pumped-storage plant in a cavern 600 m deep, with an arch dam raised, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「上池蓄能量」與「上池蓄能量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「雙饋感應電機與轉子變頻器」的模型移到南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「變速機組與抽水調節」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" and "Energy stored in the upper reservoir".
Move the model of "The doubly fed machine and its rotor converter" to Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Variable-speed units and pumping regulation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「往返效率」與「定速與變速機組的並列運轉」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Round-trip efficiency" and "Running fixed- and variable-speed units together" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant must be respecified.

related.title: 迪諾威格抽蓄水電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「往返效率」與「定速與變速機組的並列運轉」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；迪諾威格抽蓄水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Round-trip efficiency" and "Running fixed- and variable-speed units together" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Dinorwig Pumped Storage Power Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦歐洲首座大型變速抽蓄電站與瀝青面板全庫防滲的山頂上池；迪諾威格抽蓄水電站則以全地下化、十餘秒內升載的快速反應抽蓄電站為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on europe's first large variable-speed pumped-storage plant and a hilltop upper basin sealed with asphalt; Dinorwig Pumped Storage Power Station centres on A fully underground pumped-storage station that ramps within seconds, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「上池蓄能量」與「上池蓄能量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「雙饋感應電機與轉子變頻器」的模型移到迪諾威格抽蓄水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「空氣中空轉的快速備轉」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" and "Energy stored in the upper reservoir".
Move the model of "The doubly fed machine and its rotor converter" to Dinorwig Pumped Storage Power Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fast reserve by spinning in air", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「往返效率」與「定速與變速機組的並列運轉」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；迪諾威格抽蓄水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Round-trip efficiency" and "Running fixed- and variable-speed units together" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Dinorwig Pumped Storage Power Station must be respecified.
